description: All Blade views: checkout form wired to server, order confirmation page, my-orders page, admin orders index+show views, admin sidebar Orders link, dashboard stats cards, profile My Orders section. Depends on FEAT-001 (routes and controllers must exist). Independent from FEAT-001 in that view files can be written while models exist, but routes must be registered first so route() helper doesn't throw.
steps: Update resources/views/storefront/checkout.blade.php: (a) Add action={{ route('orders.store') }} and method=POST to the <form id='checkout-form'> opening tag. The @csrf is already inside the form — do not move it. (b) Rename the radio input name from 'payment' to 'payment_method' on all three radio labels (cod/bkash/nagad). (c) Replace the entire JS form.addEventListener('submit', ...) block (the setTimeout fake one) with a real fetch handler: reads Cart.getItems() (shape {id, qty, price}), appends items[i][product_id]=item.id, items[i][quantity]=item.qty, items[i][price]=item.price to FormData, POSTs to form.action with headers {X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest, Accept: application/json}, on data.success: Cart.clear() then window.location.href=data.redirect; on 422: show server errors by matching data.errors keys to [data-error='field'] spans (call showError(field,true) for each key, set span text to first error message); on network error: re-enable button. Keep the loading spinner HTML. Keep validate() and showError() functions unchanged. Keep the #order-confirmed div but it won't be used anymore (keep it hidden).

Create directory resources/views/storefront/orders/. Create resources/views/storefront/orders/show.blade.php: @extends('layouts.storefront'), @section('meta_title', 'Order '.$order->order_number.' - BanglaPuzzle'). Hero section: w-20 h-20 bg-emerald-100 rounded-full checkmark SVG (path: M5 13l4 4L19 7), h2 'Order Placed Successfully!', p with order_number in font-mono text. Below hero: lg:grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8. LEFT col: 'Order Items' heading, foreach $order->items as $item — image (three-case: str_starts_with($item->product_image,'http') ? $item->product_image : ($item->product_image ? Storage::disk('public')->url($item->product_image) : asset('images/placeholder.png'))), product_name, Qty: $item->quantity, ৳price, subtotal. RIGHT col: summary card with full_name, phone, address/city/district, payment_method badge (x-badge), subtotal/delivery_charge/total rows, 'Continue Shopping' button to route('home'). If Auth::check() && !Auth::user()->is_admin: 'View My Orders' link to route('orders.index').

Create resources/views/storefront/orders/index.blade.php: @extends('layouts.storefront'), meta_title 'My Orders - BanglaPuzzle'. Breadcrumb x-storefront.breadcrumb with [{label:'Home',url:route('home')},{label:'My Orders',url:null}]. @forelse $orders: responsive table or card list with columns Order # (link to orders.show using $order->order_number), Date ($order->created_at->format('d M Y')), Items ($order->items->count()), Total (৳number_format($order->total,2)), Status (x-badge variant=$order->status_color text=$order->status_label), View button link to orders.show. @empty: x-empty-state with shopping bag icon, title 'No orders yet', description. Pagination: {{ $orders->links() }}.

Create resources/views/admin/orders/index.blade.php: @extends('layouts.admin'), @section('title','Orders') @section('page-title','Orders'). @section('content'): x-admin.page-header title='Orders'. Status filter tabs row — a links with ?status= query: All|Pending|Confirmed|Processing|Shipped|Delivered|Cancelled. Active tab gets 'bg-blue-600 text-white' classes, inactive gets 'bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200'. Search form (GET, input name=search, Filter button, Clear link). Table in bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden: thead with Order #, Customer, Date, Items, Total, Payment, Status, Actions. @forelse $orders: order_number, customer name+email or 'Guest' if !$order->user_id, $order->created_at->format('d M Y'), $order->items_count (use withCount or items->count), ৳number_format($order->total,0), payment_method, x-badge status, View link to admin.orders.show. @empty: x-empty-state. $orders->links().

Create resources/views/admin/orders/show.blade.php: @extends('layouts.admin'), title 'Order #'.$order->order_number. Back link to admin.orders.index. Two-col lg:grid lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8. LEFT (col-span-2): Customer info card (full_name, phone, email, address/city/district/postcode/landmark), items table (image three-case, product_name, qty, price, subtotal). RIGHT (col-span-1): Order summary card (payment_method badge, subtotal, delivery, total). Below: Status update form — select#status with all 6 statuses (current selected), POST to route('admin.orders.updateStatus',$order) @csrf, 'Update Status' submit button styled bg-blue-600.

Update resources/views/layouts/admin.blade.php: after the Products <a> nav link block, add an Orders <a> block. href={{ route('admin.orders.index') }}. Active: request()->routeIs('admin.orders.*') ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 font-semibold' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'. SVG clipboard icon: path 'M9 5H7a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2M9 5a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2M9 5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2', w-4 h-4 shrink-0, stroke-width 2. Label text: Orders.

Update app/Http/Controllers/Admin/DashboardController.php: add 'use App\Models\Order;' import. Add to the view data array: 'orderCount' => Order::count(), 'pendingOrderCount' => Order::where('status','pending')->count().

Update resources/views/admin/dashboard/index.blade.php: append two more x-admin.stat-card components after the existing five. Card 1: label='Total Orders' :value='$orderCount' iconBg='bg-blue-100' iconColor='text-blue-600' iconPath='M9 5H7a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2M9 5a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2M9 5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2'. Card 2: label='Pending Orders' :value='$pendingOrderCount' iconBg='bg-orange-100' iconColor='text-orange-600' iconPath='M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z'.

Update resources/views/storefront/auth/profile.blade.php: after the change-password card div, add a new bg-white border rounded-2xl shadow-sm p-6 card section. Heading 'My Orders', short description text, a link button to route('orders.index') styled like the Save Changes buttons.
Run npm run build (exit 0) to verify all Blade changes compile.
acceptance_criteria: Checkout form POSTs to /orders with @csrf and cart items as hidden FormData fields
On successful order POST the JS redirects to /orders/{order_number}
Order confirmation page shows checkmark, order number, items, delivery address, and totals
My Orders page lists orders in a table/card with pagination and empty state
Admin orders index shows filterable/searchable list with status tabs
Admin order show page has status update form that POSTs to admin.orders.updateStatus
Admin sidebar has Orders link that highlights when on admin.orders.* routes
Dashboard shows Total Orders and Pending Orders stat cards
Profile page has My Orders section linking to orders.index
